title: A finished detached gate stays carried until the launching session's next checkpoint, so its record lands minutes late and an edit made in between fences it
outcome: When a detached full gate's terminal result exists, the host settles it (records the verification or refusal) promptly, independently of when the launching session next checkpoints. Or, if settlement must stay tied to a checkpoint, the host tells the holder in-band that the gate is finished but not yet settled, so that nobody edits the worktree on a peer's say-so before the record exists.
acceptance: A finished detached gate stays carried until the launching session's next checkpoint, so its record lands minutes late and an edit made in between fences it is done
